arc.fallback: The Wind, the Chariot, and Wamuu

description.fallback: The crowd in the arena chants Wamuu's name in anticipation for the race. The race around the nine hundred sixty meter long track will be ridden on chariots pulled by Vampire Horses, capable of going sixty kilometers an hour (roughly thirty-seven miles per hour). The first to pass each lap will be given a weapon, the first being a two-handed .
